title: Shinonome Akito — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Akito's birthday - After school
Kamiyama High School - Outside Empty Classroom
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, this classroom is where the party is.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Right!
Welcome to the venue, party of one!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hang on a minute.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What's wrong? Tenma and the rest are already inside. Let's not keep them waiting.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Not so fast. After getting this “birthday itinerary” handed to me, I've been nothing but suspicious.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? Okay, let's see what's in here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Present time, special birthday show...
It feels pretty standard for them, doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Um... I'm sure it'll be fine.
It's just an ordinary show this time.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really? I'm trusting you here.
Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Welcome, Akito.
Shiraishi, Kusanagi. Thank you for bringing him.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello. It seems everyone's assembled.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Akito!!!!
Prepare for your birth to be celebrated at full force!!!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shinonome! I'm glad we're all here to celebrate your special day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We hope you have tons and tons of fun☆

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait... Hold on a sec. Toya and the Wombos are one thing, but what are you two doing in our school?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe♪
It was a great big wonderhoy surprise plan!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I just followed Emu as she led both of us here.
I was worried someone would see us the whole time...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But it was all worth it to surprise you, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Well, I am surprised...
But hey, Mr. Hall Monitor. Is it okay to let non-students hang around in here?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It's true, they don't attend our school...
But I think one day of special permission is warranted.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As a hall monitor, I see no disruption to school order in celebrating a dear friend's precious birthday!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Come on, man, do your job.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha! Don't sweat the small stuff. Everyone's here to surprise you and turn that frown upside down, after all!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Once we heard that Tsukasa and the others planned to celebrate your birthday too, we decided to work out a plan to bring everyone in.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So you're all in cahoots.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I swear... Surprises are good and all, but you went too far this time. How were you planning to talk your way out of it if you got caught?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: In that case, we'd just call more people and have an even bigger wonderhoy party☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Right! Now, with the surprise successfully executed...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, it's present time!!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Present time...
Right, that was on the itinerary.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Come, Akito! Accept this heartfelt gift from me!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This is...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A super-size package of those popular hard gummy candies. I can guarantee their springy, chewy texture is to die for!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh, that's a pretty thoughtful present coming from you, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And from me, a large bag of soda candies.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, are these the ones you're always snacking on?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Exactly. They're made from 90% dextrose, the sugar your brain uses for fuel. Do enjoy them after practice or while studying.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay, my turn, my turn! My turn now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Ta-da☆
Phoenix Wonderland's super popular souvenir, Choco Crunchy Phenny!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... I got you a package of strawberry daifuku-flavored candy. It's only sold at amusement facilities, so I figured it'd be hard to find.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I got you a set of cookies and drip coffee. The coffee is specially blended to complement the cookies, so I hope you'll enjoy them together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I got you an assortment of baked chocolates. They won't melt on your hands, so you can eat them while you're working.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
And I got you some rum raisin buttercream sandwich cookies!
The rum raisin flavor goes so great with the buttercream.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Wow... Thanks, you guys.
But is it just me, or are these mostly sweets?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We heard from Aoyagi that you've been studying really hard lately. So we decided to each get you snacks you could enjoy while working.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh... Right.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We've heard you're all reaching for a new goal, after all! So, let's all keep working hard for our respective dreams.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I bet having lots of yummy things to enjoy will help you have fun studying, too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We can't do much to support you directly, but we hope that we can provide at least a little help.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You heard them, Akito! Everyone's got our backs, so let's not let them down!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, for sure.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Seems I'll be set for snacks for a good while. Thanks, guys. I'll enjoy them.
